description: This is a false-colour infrared satellite image depicting an agricultural landscape. A central, approximately trapezoidal-shaped field is demarcated by a magenta polygon outline. Within this highlighted field, distinct parallel rows of active vegetation are visible as dark red-brown strips, separated by lighter, bluish-white inter-row areas, characteristic of vineyards or similar row crop cultivation. Surrounding the highlighted area are other agricultural fields exhibiting varied land cover, including areas with uniform bright red tones indicative of dense, healthy vegetation, and areas with blue-green hues, possibly representing bare soil, less vigorous vegetation, or different crop types. The image detail is consistent with high-resolution satellite imagery, such as Spot 5 with 2.5 m resolution, and likely depicts a scene from around 2010, based on similar contextual images.
